### From Rubble to Restoration
Author: Christine Hoover
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/from-rubble-to-restoration
Passage: Nehemiah 9:17
Points:
- Reflecting on past sin and personal failure can leave us feeling like we are staring at ruins.
- Nehemiah confronted Jerusalem's devastation by mourning and confessing the people's sins to God.
- God meets a broken and contrite heart with unfailing pardon, compassion, and patience.
- Jesus weeps over spiritual brokenness and invites people to turn to Him for renewal.
- Divine grace does not merely forgive wrongdoing; it rebuilds shattered lives.

### Bible Pathway - June 9, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-june-9-2010-11632875.html
Passage: Nehemiah 9:1-38
Points:
- Hearing and understanding Scripture prompts deep conviction, genuine confession, and authentic worship.
- The community humbled themselves in fasting and repentance while exalting God's eternal name.
- Reviewing Israel's history reveals God's generous provision and His Spirit's faithful guidance.
- Believers are urged to rely on the Holy Spirit to walk in obedience and covenant faithfulness.
